construct: Intention-to-treat analysis preserves the prognostic balance created by randomization by analyzing participants according to their originally assigned treatment group, regardless of nonadherence, crossover, or treatment discontinuation. It estimates the effect of treatment assignment rather than efficacy among adherers.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: When the goal is to preserve the causal benefit of randomization despite crossover and nonadherence, participants remain analyzed in their originally assigned groups under the intention-to-treat principle.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: As-treated, per-protocol, complete-case adherent, and crossover reassignment analyses all condition on post-randomization behavior or treatment received and do not preserve the randomized treatment-assignment comparison.
